brief.idea: a proud fox and a patient tortoise share the last water in the desert

premise.title: A Sip for Two
premise.logline: Fox must share the last pool with Tortoise before the sun dries it, or they will both go thirsty.
premise.theme: Pride hoards, but patience and sharing make a little water enough for all.
premise.hook: In a vast red desert, a tiny blue pool is the last water for miles—and Fox races toward it, only to see Tortoise already taking a calm sip.
premise.stakes: If Fox wastes or guards the last water, he and Tortoise will have nothing to drink, and the hot desert will win.
tools: a ticking clock: before sunset dries the last pool
rising stakes: every splash makes the pool smaller
dramatic irony: Tortoise knows slow sips save water, Fox does not
a false victory: Fox thinks standing guard wins him the pool
the 'it cannot get worse' beat: Fox drinks too fast and coughs, wasting more water
premise.want: to drink the whole pool alone
premise.obstacle: Tortoise, already sipping, wants a fair share.
premise.clock: before sunset, when the desert heat dries the pool
premise.normalDay: Fox races the wind, boasts to the dunes, and drinks first at every pool.
premise.whyToday: He finds the very last pool in the desert—and Tortoise is already there.
premise.whyCare: Fox is small, dusty and desperately thirsty; Tortoise greets him with a gentle nod instead of a challenge.

oddity.what: The fox and tortoise talk and reason like people.
oddity.rule: They speak, but they keep their animal natures: Fox is quick and proud, Tortoise is slow and steady.

spine: Once upon a time, in the red desert, a proud fox found the last pool of water at an oasis.
Every day, Fox raced from dune to dune, boasting he was the fastest and took what he wanted.
Until one day, he came to the last waterhole and found a patient tortoise already there, drinking slowly.
Because of that, Fox shouted that the pool was his and tried to drink it all before sunset, but he only splashed and puffed and grew thirstier.
Until finally, Tortoise showed him how to take one small sip and leave some for the next, and Fox saw the pool was enough for both.
Ever since then, when Fox comes to water, he drinks his fill and leaves half, and he and Tortoise share the oasis in peace.
